question: What post-subagent completion contract should OpenClaw support, if any, and how should it bound child output/history exposure plus announcement mutation, suppression, and delivery-result visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the payload, ordering, timeout/error handling, redaction, audit behavior, and plugin authority are security-sensitive public API choices that automation should not lock in.

options.title: Typed Plugin Delivery Hook
options.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Lifecycle Design
options.body: Hold this narrow request until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43454 settles one event model across subagents, turns, and tool thresholds.

options.title: Observation-Only Event
options.body: Expose only a non-mutating completion event and leave announcement mutation or suppression to separate delivery-policy work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Typed Plugin Delivery Hook
recommendation.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent subagent thread-binding work and the maintainer comment rejecting the overlapping guard-hook PR make this the strongest available owner for the product and security contract choice.
